title: lannea schweinfurthii
intro: Lannea schweinfurthii, commonly known as the African sterculia or Schweinfurth's sterculia, is a plant species in the Anacardiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lannea schweinfurthii are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and act as a purgative, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Lannea schweinfurthii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
